hypothesis: A directly observed, boundary-consistent increase in the energy system's reinvestment/capital requirement may explain incremental industrial investment burden beyond the unchanged World3 reference mechanism, if the bridge is measurable and improves time-respecting prediction.
null_model: unchanged World3-compatible reference core with no new energy feedback
explicitly_rejected_reuse: World3 fraction of resources remaining -> fossil EROI

measurement_boundaries.gross_energy: Energy Institute Total Energy Supply / source-specific physical energy accounting, vintage preserved
measurement_boundaries.eroi_rule: Never mix EROI boundaries in one calibration target. Treat each boundary as a separate observational/diagnostic series.
measurement_boundaries.industrial_target: independent industrial/manufacturing output diagnostic at a consistent real-volume boundary
measurement_boundaries.bridge_required_before_estimation: direct or defensible observed energy-sector reinvestment/capital-requirement share mapped to the same economic investment boundary used by the industrial-capital interface

missing_precondition: No currently registered series directly identifies the global translation from energy reinvestment requirement to World3-compatible industrial investment burden. This bridge must be sourced and audited before S4 estimation or S7-S10 behavioral testing.

structural_gates.S1: specified: energy accounting remains outside the reference core until the bridge is identified; no hidden resource-to-EROI proxy
structural_gates.S2: specified: gross energy, energy reinvestment and industrial investment burden must be distinct quantities with double-counting audit
structural_gates.S3: specified: the bridge must map dimensionless reinvestment share or currency/year capital requirement to a dimensionally compatible industrial allocation quantity
structural_gates.S5: predeclared: zero energy burden must leave reference output unchanged; finite burdens may not create negative stocks or allocations
structural_gates.S6: predeclared: conclusions must be stable under stricter integration/numerical settings

temporal_validation.rule: Use only vintages available at each forecast origin. Select origins after the bridge series is registered, before inspecting evaluation outcomes.
temporal_validation.baseline_comparison: same World3 reference core, observations, origins and loss functions with candidate interface dormant
temporal_validation.holdout_rule: Previously inspected holdouts cannot be relabelled as untouched confirmation. Preserve failed attempts in the audit trail.

decision_rule.r2: selection only; no promotion is possible in R2
decision_rule.future_experiment: The candidate can advance only if S1-S10 are all explicitly passed using a predeclared metric-specific acceptance rule and the simpler reference model on the same information set.
decision_rule.failure: Return the mechanism to diagnostic/stress status; do not retune against the same holdout.

double_counting_guard: Do not add an energy-derived industrial-capital burden to the inherited World3 resource-acquisition burden unless the two empirical cost boundaries are demonstrated to be non-overlapping or an explicit reconciliation rule is validated.
